notes.title: Ultra Imposer Releasing Soon!
notes.content:
Get your thumbs ready. Ultra Imposer is releasing 05/20/22 at 12:00am EST.

It's been a while since I've posted, but Ultra Imposer is very nearly upon us and It's seen a change or two since its demo build.  

[list]
[*] Gamepad support has been dropped for the more friendly tracked-controller pointer.  This allowed for more focus on game-play balance and has also proven to be the more fun option.

[*] The Imposer Drone now fires repeatedly for a short time with a single trigger-push stopping just before engaging lock-on targeting.
[/list]

I really appreciate the feedback I received from the demo, folks!  It helped to build a better game. 

I hope this post finds you all well. 

flapjax out! <3
